script: Halley's Comet swings past Earth about every 76 years. It was last seen from Earth in 1986. It will be back in 2061. Each time it passes the Sun, it sheds dust that later makes meteor showers. Its core is a dirty snowball about 15 kilometers long. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
